# Story 18.1: Red-phase unit tests for extracted universe services and shared response mapper

Status: in-progress

## Story

As a developer,
I want red-phase unit tests asserting the universe business logic lives in service functions and add/get share one response mapper,
So that Story 18.2 has a defined, executable contract to make pass when it extracts the largest route file (P1 item #1 from Aspect 9 of the critical review).

## Acceptance Criteria

1. A spec asserts that `deleteUniverseAndTrades` and `isUniverseDeletable` are callable from service functions (not defined inline in `universe/index.ts`).
2. A spec asserts that the add and get endpoints produce identical response shapes through one shared response mapper — no hand-built zero responses duplicated between them.
3. All assertions in AC #1–#2 are marked `.skip()` (`it.skip`) so the server Vitest suite runs green BEFORE Story 18.2 exists — red-phase by skip, not by failure. Existing passing tests remain unskipped and green.
4. The spec file(s) run green under `nx test server` immediately after this story (new red-phase tests skipped), and Story 18.2's first task is to remove the `.skip()` markers, confirm they FAIL against current code, then implement until they pass.

## Tasks / Subtasks

- [x] Task 1 (AC: #1): Add a service-extraction assertion for `deleteUniverseAndTrades` and `isUniverseDeletable`.
  - [x] 1.1 In a spec under `apps/server/src/app/routes/universe/`, assert that `deleteUniverseAndTrades` and `isUniverseDeletable` are exported from service functions (not defined inline in the route handler).
- [ ] Task 2 (AC: #2): Add a shared-response-mapper assertion for add/get.
  - [ ] 2.1 Assert that the add and get endpoints produce identical response shapes through one shared mapper — no hand-built zero responses duplicated between them.
- [ ] Task 3 (AC: #3, #4): Mark red-phase assertions `.skip()` and confirm green.
  - [ ] 3.1 Apply `it.skip` to every assertion added in Tasks 1–2 — they are red until Story 18.2 extracts the services. Leave all pre-existing tests unskipped.
  - [ ] 3.2 Run `nx test server` and confirm fully green with only the new red-phase tests skipped. Do NOT weaken or delete any assertion to achieve this — skip markers only.

## Dev Notes

- **Why:** `universe/index.ts` is the largest server route file; it contains inline `deleteUniverseAndTrades`, `isUniverseDeletable`, and hand-built zero responses for add/get. Extracting into services + one shared mapper shrinks the file and removes duplication (P1 item #1 from Aspect 9).
- **Red-phase TDD:** this story is ordered before Story 18.2. Assertions are marked `it.skip` so CI stays green while the logic is still inline; Story 18.2's first task removes the skip markers, confirms red, then extracts until green.
- **Do NOT modify production code in this story** — unit-test scaffold only. The extraction belongs to Story 18.2.
- Vitest is the workspace test framework; server tests run via `nx test server`.

### Project Structure Notes

- Create/modify: a spec under `apps/server/src/app/routes/universe/` (add skipped service-extraction + shared-mapper assertions).
- No changes to production `.ts` in this story.
